|ingredients = {{Name|Wood|10}}{{Name|Copper Ore|2}}{{Name|Fiber|20}} |sellprice = 100 |quality = false |recipe = {{NPC|Robin|6-heart event}} }} The '''Flute Block''' is a [[Crafting|crafted]] piece of [[Furniture]]. The recipe can be obtained from [[Robin]]'s 6 heart event. One Flute Block is the reward for donating 3 [[artifacts]] that include the [[Bone Flute]] to the [[Museum]]. ==Music== A placed Flute Block emits a sound when a player walks next to it, and then once per second if they stay near it. You can right-click a Flute Block to increase its pitch. There are 25 possible pitches, after which right-clicking again will reset to the first one. You can place a series of Flute Blocks and [[Drum Block]]s to create music as you walk along them. {|class="wikitable" style="text-align: center;" |- |+ Pitch tuning ! scope="row" | Clicks | 0 || 1 ||
